properties.name: r2.account-id
properties.description: Cloudflare account ID for R2 (env R2_ACCOUNT_ID).

properties.name: r2.access-key-id
properties.description: R2 API token access key ID (env R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID).

properties.name: r2.secret-access-key
properties.description: R2 API token secret access key (env R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY).

properties.name: r2.bucket
properties.description: R2 bucket shared by all restaurants (env R2_BUCKET).

properties.name: r2.public-url
properties.description: Public bucket URL or custom domain, e.g. https://images.example.com (env R2_PUBLIC_URL).

properties.name: restaurant.slug
properties.description: Folder of this restaurant inside the bucket, only a-z, 0-9 and '-' (env RESTAURANT_SLUG).
